GENERATE BURST KV-S3 — Run C-9 P7, S gorget fix (Matt: "the neck line lost its width and upturn"). task_id "KV-S3".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 (the knight facing the viewer). Change ONLY his GORGET — the steel collar between the helm and the shoulders. It has become narrow and flat. Make it the gorget of IMAGE 2 (the same knight, same view, before): a WIDE steel collar that spreads out over the tops of the shoulders and whose upper rim FLARES OUTWARD and UPWARD in a pronounced upturned lip around the base of the helm, like a funnel, as also seen in IMAGES 3 and 4 from the diagonals.
Keep the HELM AND VISOR EXACTLY as in IMAGE 1 (they are approved; do not touch them). Keep everything else exactly: body, pose, tabard and heraldry, pollaxe in his right hand, size, position, flat pure #00ff00 background; same painted hand. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY THE IMAGES: do not restyle.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if the gorget is still narrow or flat, the helm or visor changed, anything else changed, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/KV-S3_a.png and out/KV-S3_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "KV-S3"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE IMAGE TO EDIT (change only the gorget; helm and visor approved)
IMAGE 2 — the gorget to restore (same knight, same view): wide, flared, upturned
IMAGE 3 — the gorget from the lower-right diagonal
IMAGE 4 — the gorget from the lower-left diagonal
